newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zwack says 9-mo results in line with plans.
newsitem.headline: Zwack says 9-mo results in line with plans.

text.p: Hungarian spirits maker Zwack Unicum Rt said on Thursday that its sales and pre-tax profits in the January-September period were in line with its plans.

Zwack released its nine-month consolidated IAS results this morning and said its gross sales revenues rose to 9.871 billion forints from 8.352 billion in the same period of 1995 while its 377 million forint pre-tax profit was up by 60 million.
The company said Hungary's illegal alcohol sales continued to have a negative impact on its domestic sales.
"The legal alcohol market continued to shrink and our domestic sales in volumes were 1.8 percent below those in the same period of last year," Zwack said in its results report.
The group had generated 458 million forints from exports although it saw a setback in its sales to countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States due to changes in import rules there.
Export revenues accounted for 7.93 percent of total net sales in the first nine months of 1996, it said.
Costs were also in line with plans with the exception of delivery costs.
Zwack said the group's investments reached an accumulated 356 million forints during the nine months.
"The implementation of main projects are in line with plans and the test production in the new distillery in Kecskemet will start in November."
